fee_notes: Standard fee $71,000 for ~100,000 HH territory. Veterans and First Responders pay $61,000. Additional territories at same time as initial: $60,000 each. Existing franchisees in good standing with >$1M gross sales: 50% of then-current fee. Additional software license fee of $6,000 per franchise agreement required prior to initial training.
raw_excerpt: You must pay us an initial franchise fee of $71,000 (the "Initial Franchise Fee"), which is due in full upon signing of the Franchise Agreement... We offer qualified veterans of the U.S. Armed Forces... the right to acquire an initial franchise for a reduced Initial Franchise Fee amounting to $61,000.
